title: Sculptra collagen stimulation in Cairo
description: Read about Sculptra in Cairo, including how gradual collagen stimulation differs from immediate volume, how recovery is monitored and when to report lumps.
answer: Sculptra is an injectable collagen stimulator considered for some changes in facial volume. Its effect develops gradually and varies between people. At {{brand}} in New Cairo and Mohandessin, adults can discuss whether their anatomy, health and expectations make this approach suitable and how it differs from a gel filler.
preparation: Discuss previous fillers, scarring and unexplained facial lumps. Active inflammation or an unclear diagnosis is a reason to postpone injection.
howPerformed: The consultation maps the areas of volume change. If agreed, the team places the product and arranges a review before considering further treatment.
followup: Early fullness may reflect swelling. Follow the aftercare for this product and report persistent lumps, redness or discomfort.
risks: Bruising and swelling are possible. Nodules may develop later. Severe pain, skin colour changes or visual symptoms require urgent assessment.
